book.name: LUKASI
book.title: NHALU GHWA MAHA PAGHUTYEKITWE NA LUKASI

content: Yesu kangualaghila ahundwa bhake mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili
Yesu kakiakema bhala ahundwa mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili papamu, na kakiapegha likalama na makakala gha kughabhuha mandilu ghoha na kualamiha atamwa bhoha,
mbole kakialaghila aghende kulandamiha bhandu Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga na kualamiha atamwa.
Kakialaghila pakilongela, “Pammegha mumwanja nkotoke kutola kilibhi kyohele, ebu nkongocho, ebu nhako, ebu hilyo, ebu mbiya, ebu lighwanda lya kuhemengana.
Lubhagha lwohele lu muluyingila, ntame amwo mbaka panmpala kubhuka mu kitami akyo.
Handa bhandu paabhalema kubhakingama, mmuke mukitami kyabhe, npumunde lihu mumaghulu ghenu ngati yibhe uyimiho na naho ya lukinyo kwa uhakata ghwabhe.”
Ndo bhala ahundwa bhakibhuka bhakighenda kijiji mbaka kijiji, paakiaghombela bhandu Nhalo ghwa Maha na kualamiha atamwa kwoha.
Mutwa Helode kanguyingilwa na bhwaghalili.
Ndo mutwa Helode, ntabhala ghwa Galilaya kakiyihwa mihalo hyoha yakatendite Yesu, kakiyingilwa na bhwaghalili kiyaha amoo bhandu akilongela kukita Yohane yunakubatisa kahyuka.
Bhangi bhakilongela kukita Eliya ywakabheghite mbuye ghwa Chapanga kabhabwitukila, na bhangi bhakilongela yumoo bha mambuye bha makachu kahyuka.
Peni Helode kakilongela, “Yohane nikinndumula mutwe. Peni aywo ndo ghani niyiyihwite mihalo yake?” Ndo kakipala kummona.
Yesu kanguapegha hilyo bhandu Elfu nhano
Bhala andumitumi bhake paabhuyite, bhaking'ombela Yesu hyoha hyaatendite. Yesu kakiatola na kakighenda nabho pa kighweka mbaka kitami kimo kiikemitwe Betisaida.
Peni lumati lwa bhandu palumanyite paaghendite, lukintughila. Ndo Yesu akiakingama na kakiyobhela nabho ya kya Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga na kualamiha bhala bhoha bhaapalite kulamihwa.

Payihegheghelite makimuhi, bhala ahundwa mbinda mabhoko yimo na abhili bhakinng'endela Yesu na bhakinng'ombela, “Ghululaghe lumati alu lwa bhandu lubhuke ngati aghende mu hijiji na mumighunda ya ugheghela, ngati bhakapalahe hilyo na ng'ebhu ya kughonja, kiyaha apa tubhegha pa manyahi.”

Peni Yesu kakiaghombela, “Mubhapeghe mwenga hilyo.” Nabho bhakinnyanga, “Tubhegha na kyohele ng'obhe, ngati nga mangate nhano na homba abhili, pangi tughende tukahemele hilyo hya kukwila bhandu bhoha abha?”
Kiyaha akibhegha bhandu Elfu nhano. Ndo Yesu kakiaghombela ahundwa bhake, “Muaghombele bhandu atame mu himati hya bhandu mbinda mabhoko nhano.”
Ahundwa bhakitenda handa aghombilitwe na Yesu, bhakiatamiha pahi bhandu bhoha.

Mbole Yesu kakighatola ghala mangate nhano na bhala homba abhili, kakilolekeha kunani pakinnumba Chapanga, kakiyinonela na kuyimetulanga, mbole kakiapegha ahundwa bhake alupeghe lula lumati lwoha lwa bhandu.
Bhandu bhoha bhakilyegha na akiyukuta. Ahundwa bhakikungana mahighalo ghahighalite, na ghakimema hikapu mbinda mabhoko yimo na hibhili.
Petili kangukambuka kukita Yesu ndo Kilisto ghwa kya Chapanga
Linjubha limo Yesu pakabheghite mu kuyupa pakighweka, na ahundwa bhake bhakibhegha ugheghela. Ndo kakiakonyekeha, “Bhandu angulongela kukita nenga ndo ghani?”

Nabho bhakinnyanga, “Bhangi angulongela kukita ghwenga ndo Yohane yunakubatisa, bhangi angulongela kukita ghwenga ndo Eliya na bhangi angulongela, ghwenga ndo yumoo ywa ambuye bha makachu kahyuka kuhuma kwa bhaahweghite.”
Mbole kakiakonyekeha, “Bhuli mwenga, mungulongela kukita nenga ndo ghani?” Petili kakinnyanga, “Ghwenga ndo Kilisito ywakahaghulitwe na Chapanga.”
Yesu kangulondola ya kya kimbamanda kyake na kuhwegha
Mbole Yesu kakiakwilikiha akotoke kunng'ombela mundu ywohele nhalo aghu.
Yesu kakighendelela kakilongela, “Yingunnogha Mwana ghwa Mundu
kapati himbamanda hitangalo na kulemwa na aghohi, na andundame akulu na ahunda bha malaghilo naywo katakomwa na mu linjubha lya ndatu katahyuka.”
Mbole kakiaghombela bhoha, “Ywohele ywakapala kunndughila yingunnogha kalileme mwene, kakatole lupingika lwake manjubha ghoha na kakandughile.
Kiyaha ywohele ywakapala kughulopoha ubhumi ghwake kataghuhoha, peni ywohele ywakaghuhoha ubhumi ghwake kwa kya nenga, kataghulopoha.
Hinu, yibhegha hupo yoki kwa mundu kughukamula nnima ghwoha, na kulikanjaghana mwene?

Handa mundu ywohele ywakamonela honi nenga na malagho gha nenga, Mwana ghwa Mundu naywo katammonela honi mundu aywo paahika Muukulu ghwake na Muukulu ghwa Tate na ghwa mahoka bha Chapanga na bhaabhaghulitwe kwakya Chapanga.
Kulyaghila nunguaghombela hoto, amoo bhandu bha abheghite apa bhene bhatahwegha ng'obhe mbaka pakapala kughubhona Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga.”
Yesu kangughalambuka kibhungi
Ghakikinda manjubha nhano na ndatu mbole gha kughalongela ghala, Yesu kakiatola Petili, na Yakobu na Yohane kakighenda nabho ku kitumbi kunnyupa Chapanga.
Pakabheghite mu kuyupa, mmonekano ghwa kibhungi kyake ghukighalambuka, maghwanda ghake ghaking'anyima mbuletee.
Kamu bhakiabhona bhandu abhili, Musa na Eliya paakiyobhela na Yesu,
bhala bha abwitukiliti akibhegha muukulu, paakilyobhela na Yesu yakya kuyomoka kwake kuupala kutulukila akwo Yelusalemu.
Petili na ayake akibhegha mung'ono ngulu, hata habhu kamu bhakiyimuka, bhakighubhona ukulu ghwa Yesu na bha bhala abhili bhaayimite papamu naywo.

Musa na Eliya, paabheghite mu kubhuka, Petili kakinng'ombela Yesu, “Bambo yibha maha tubha apa! Hinu tuchenge matinga mandatu, limoo lyako, limoo lya Musa na limoo lingi lya Eliya” Peni Petili kakimanya ng'obhe kyakalongilite.
Petili pakabheghite kakali pakalongela likihuluka lihundi na likiagubika, nabho bhakiyoghopa paayingilite mu lila lihundi.
Lilobhe likiyihwanika kuhuma mulila lihundi palikilongela, “Ayu ndo mwana ghwangu npalo nenga Chapanga, yununhaghulitie, munnyihwe mwene.”
Mbole ya lilobhe alyo kuyihwanika, bhakimmona Yesu pakibhegha ghweka chake. Bhala ahundwa bhakinyamala jii na mumanjubha agho bhakinng'ombela ng'obhe mundu ywohele ghala ghaaghabhonite.
Yesu kangunlamiha nhongolo yuna lindilu
Kilabho yake, Yesu papamu na ahundwa bhake andatu paahulukite kuhuma ku kitumbi, kakikongana na lumati lukulu lwa bhandu.
Mundu yumu mu lula lumati lwa bhandu kakichobha kyobho paakilongela, “Nhunda, nungukuyupa ghunlolekehe mwana ghwangu, ndo mwana ghwangu ghwa kighweka.

Pipipi lindilu lingunkwela na kuntenda kayobhe kyobho, mbole lingunng'wigha pahi na linguntenda kabhe na kihilika na lihuluhulu likimmuka mu ngulu yake. Alyo lindilu lingunbamanda muno na likinlekekeha ng'obhe kya kuyumbatika.
Nikiayupa ahundwa bhako alibhuhe alyo lindilu peni bhakilepelwa.”
Yesu kakiyanga pakilongela, “Mwenga kibheleko kya nga uhyubhalilo na kinakuhokela, nda tama na mwenga na kualimbilila mbaka pakiki?” Mbole kakinng'ombela yula mundu, “Ghunnyeghe mwana ghwako apa.”

Yula nhongolo pakabheghite mukunhikila Yesu, lila lindilu likinng'wiha pahi, likinnyingiha kihilika. Peni Yesu kakilikwilikiha lila lindilu limmuke, kakinnamiha yula mwana na kakimmuyiha kwa tate ghwake

Bhandu bhoha bhakikangacha makakala makulu gha Chapanga. Yesu kangukambuka kangi ya kya kiho kyake Matayu 17:22-23; Maliki 9:30-32 Bhala bhandu paabheghite akali angukangacha ghoha ghakatendite Yesu, mwene kakiaghombela ahundwa bhake,
“Nkingikihee makutu ghenu, namuyiyihwe mihalu ayi, Mwana ghwa Mundu kangughenda kukilukwa na kukamuhwa mu mabhoko gha bhandu.”
Peni bhombe bhakimanya ng'obhe fwamulo yake niki. Kiyaha fwambulo ya mihalu ayo yikihihwa kwabhe, habhu bhakighamanya ng'obhe, nabho bhakiyoghopa kunkonya fwambulo ya malagho agho.
Ywoki ndo nkulu?
Ghakibwituka maghombano mu bhala ahundwa bha Yesu gha kya ghani ywakapala kubhegha nkulu mu bhoha,
peni Yesu kakighamanya mahwacho gha myoyo yabhe, kakintola mwana nndokwa na kakinnyimiha mu ugheghela ghwake,

mbole kakiaghombela, “Mundu ywohele yunakunkingama mwana nndokwa kiyaha kanguliyitikila lihina lyangu, mudu aywo kangunngingama nenga, na ywohele ywakangingama nenga, kangunkingama yula ywakanaghilite, kiyaha yula ywakabheghite nndokwa kupitingana kwa bhoha mumwenga aywo ndo nkulu kupitingana bhoha.”
Ywa nga kuapingika mwenga kabha mu mbande ya mwenga
Yohane kakilongela, “Bambo tummona mundu pakighabhua mandilu kwa bhandu kwa lihina lyako, twenga tunkanikiha, kiyaha mwene kabha yumoo ywetu ng'obhe.”
Yesu kakiaghombela, “Nkotoke kunkanikiha, kiyaha ywohele ywa nga kupingikana na mwenga kabhegha mu mbande yenu.”
Bhandu bha kijiji kya Samalia angulema kunnkingama Yesu
Manjubha paghaheghelelite kwa Yesu kutolwa kughenda kunani kwa Chapanga, mwene kakikamala kughenda ku Yelusalemu.
Habhu kakialaghiha bhandu bhanlongolele, nabho bhakighenda na bhakiyingila mu kijiji kimo kya Akaasamalia kunkeyela hyoha,
peni akolannima bha kijiji kila bhakinkingama ng'obhe kiyaha kakibhegha mu mwanja ghwake kughenda ku Yelusalemu.
Ahundwa bhake ndo Yohane na Yakobu paabhonite agho, bhakilongela, “Bambo, ghupala tughukwilikihe mwoto ghuhuluke kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga ghubhayoche?”
Peni mwene Yesu kakikilibhuka na kualakalila.
Nabho bhakibhuka na bhakighenda ku kijiji kingi.
Ateghekwa bha kuntughila Yesu
Pakabheghite munjila pakighenda, Mundu yumu kakinng'ombela Yesu, “Ndaghutughila kwohele kughughenda.”
Yesu kakinnyanga, “Mabweha abhegha na mbako na hiyuni hya kunani abhegha na hiyumba, peni Mwana ghwa Mundu kabhegha ng'obhe na pakulighonjeha.”
Mbole Yesu kakinng'ombela mundu yungi, “Ghundughile.” Peni yula mundu kakinnyanga, “Bambo, ghundegheke huti ngankulile tate ghwangu.”
Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Ghualeke bhanakuhwegha mu myoyo yabhe abhakulile bhaahweghite bhabhe, ngati ghwenga ghughende ghukaghulandamihe Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga.”
Mundu yungi kakinng'ombela, “Bambo, ndaghutughila peni ghundegheke huti ngaalaghe alongo bhangu.”
Yesu kakinng'ombela, “Mundu ywohele ywakapala kukanda lutupi, mbole kangulolekeha kuhyeto, kalemwa mu Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga.”
